def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=bg and x!=0]
    i0=min(p[0] for p in pts); i1=max(p[0] for p in pts); j0=min(p[1] for p in pts); j1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    shape=[[g[i][j] for j in range(j0,j1+1)] for i in range(i0,i1+1)]
    shape=[r[::-1] for r in shape]  # horizontal mirror hypothesis
    z=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==0]

    return a
